findings.observation: The points in every row are as large as the screen title and push the names to a few characters
findings.suggested_fix: Use .dsFont(.label) with .monospacedDigit() for the points; .display is the screen's hero style

findings.observation: At the large text size the points keep their full width and the row runs past the right edge
findings.suggested_fix: Remove .fixedSize(); give the points layoutPriority(1) and minimumScaleFactor(0.7), and let the name truncate

findings.observation: The balance is drawn in system blue, which is not in the palette
findings.suggested_fix: DS.Colors.ink for the balance; vermilion is reserved for the primary action

findings.guideline: Keep at most one primaryButton per screen
findings.observation: Two filled vermilion buttons, stacked under the card
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the top-up as primaryButton; the second action becomes secondaryButton
